scope: Interrupted 2000-step prefix only; final episode outcome remains pending.

first_execution_failure.details: 60-step approach did not settle; guard cancelled descent, closure and lift. Astra repeated approach and descent at 100 steps each.

first_unrecovered_physical_break.details: Insertion targets were reached, but the shaft tip stayed approximately 12 cm from the stand base. Before withdrawal, shaft-between-wall and stand-upright checks passed while tip-depth check failed. The released frame was shallowly seated, not fully assembled.

later_events.details: Opposite retreat caught frame against open gripper hand/finger; shaft no longer between walls at step 1150.
Vertical clearance left frame on table by step 1250; Astra recognized failed seating and chose recovery.
Contact-blocked recovery approaches cancelled later phases; one later reached closure missed the shaft. Astra cleared view for further assessment.

boundary: Private diagnostic results were never passed to Astra or executor.
limitations: Rebuilt contacts identify contact geometry, not measured forces or proof of a unique causal mechanism. No successful task outcome or comparative advantage follows from this unfinished prefix.
